precision_note: This simulation mixes several different kinds of precision and labels every entity accordingly. AIRCRAFT positions are real ADS-B GPS coordinates from the adsb.lol archive. GROUND positions (Kirk, Robinson, the SUV) are SCHEMATIC — no public source gives surveyed coordinates for the Losee Center rooftop or the Fountain Courtyard; the ~127m rooftop-to-courtyard distance and the ~30m security perimeter radius ARE sourced and preserved proportionally, but compass bearing and exact footprints are illustrative. SURROUNDING BUILDINGS shown (Pope Science, Sorensen Student Center, Student Life & Wellness) are real named adjacent structures per UVU's own campus map, but their drawn size and placement relative to each other are illustrative context, not a surveyed site plan. SECURITY PERSONNEL markers are REPRESENTATIVE, not individually located — the count (6 UVU officers) and posture (private detail in concentric zones, no one assigned to roofs or doors) are sourced; no public record places any specific officer at a specific point.

time_window.note: Slider range. Aircraft traces are sampled every ~20 seconds within this window; ground events use the sourced timestamps above.

satellite.note: This image is real satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery / Maxar), not an illustration. The fountain courtyard was identified directly from the visible fountain feature in this image and cross-checked against OpenStreetMap's building layout — it is a real, visually-confirmed position, not a schematic placement. The Losee Center building outline (drawn on the map) is the real building footprint from OpenStreetMap, not an illustration. The roof/firing-position marker is placed at the building edge nearest the courtyard, which is a reasonable approximation, not a surveyed point: measured on this image the distance from the courtyard to that edge is approximately 90m, while forensic reporting and preliminary-hearing testimony give approximately 127m to the specific firing position, which this app has not independently pinpointed within the building footprint. Small offsets used to separate individual people/vehicles at the same general location (a few meters in the underlying data) are for visual legibility only and do not represent surveyed individual positions.

ground_events.headline: On campus, exact path undocumented
ground_events.event: Surveillance testimony places Robinson on the UVU campus (four separate appearances documented before the shooting). Precise path/coordinates for these earlier appearances are not publicly detailed — case agent David Hull identified him across cameras by gait ('stiff-right-leg' pattern), footwear, and a clothing change (shirt/shorts to dark pants and long sleeves with an American-flag graphic) in a stairwell, not a fixed route.

ground_events.headline: Concentric protective zones established around the stage
ground_events.event: Private security builds concentric protective zones roughly 30 meters around the stage, with double presidential-style barricades and vehicles as hard barriers behind the stage. Six UVU police officers are working the event, some in plainclothes monitoring the crowd. No one from UVU is assigned to check the roofs or be stationed at the doors — the gap that would matter roughly 40 minutes later.

ground_events.headline: On the ground with the security detail he led
ground_events.event: Harpole formed Rockhouse Integrity Group in 2023 and held the TPUSA event-security contract. This app's Whereabouts Audit found he was on the ground with the security team at UVU on September 10 -- distinct from the disputed Fort Huachuca allegation about September 9, for which his own defamation complaint asserts travel records place him in Dallas. Placement here is schematic; no source gives his exact standing location pre-event.

ground_events.headline: Event begins
ground_events.event: Charlie Kirk's American Comeback Tour stop begins at the UVU Fountain Courtyard, seated at his 'Prove Me Wrong' table, with roughly 3,000 people in attendance.

ground_events.headline: Operating the camera positioned directly behind Kirk
ground_events.event: Farnsworth, principal of Visual Impulse LLC (the 'Impulse' named in preliminary-hearing testimony as supplying four video angles from the day), operated the camera positioned directly behind Kirk. This is the camera and card at the center of this app's chain-of-custody deep dive -- police did not seize the original recording media at the scene; Farnsworth removed it and transferred its contents to a flash drive himself.

ground_events.headline: Crouches on the Losee Center roof
ground_events.event: Surveillance shows Robinson crouching on the Losee Center rooftop, roughly 127m from the event.

ground_events.headline: Roughly 20 minutes into the event
ground_events.event: Seated at his 'Prove Me Wrong' table in the UVU Fountain Courtyard, roughly 20 minutes into the event.

ground_events.headline: Takes a prone firing position
ground_events.event: Takes a prone firing position at the corner of the Losee Center roof, facing the courtyard. Prone-position impressions (elbows, knees, feet) were later photographed there with a measuring tape.

ground_events.headline: Single shot fired — Kirk fatally struck
ground_events.event: Single shot fired from the Losee Center rooftop, fatally striking Charlie Kirk at the courtyard table.

ground_events.headline: Flees across the roof to the NE corner
ground_events.event: Flees across the rooftop to the northeast corner and descends — a shoe impression was photographed there. The distinctive gait was absent during this run, attributed by the case agent to adrenaline.

ground_events.headline: Security moves to Kirk immediately
ground_events.event: Brian Harpole (security chief) and the protective detail move to Kirk. Frank Turek — present at the event, described as close to Kirk — also converges on the scene rather than leaving the area.

ground_events.headline: Converges on Kirk with the protective detail
ground_events.event: Harpole and the protective detail move to Kirk immediately after the shot, per this app's existing security-response finding.

ground_events.headline: Present at the event, converges rather than leaving
ground_events.event: Turek -- present at the event, described as close to Kirk -- converges on the scene rather than leaving the area. He later gave the most direct available account of the evacuation drive, saying better first aid, better facilities, or a faster trip might have saved Kirk.

ground_events.headline: Removes the camera and SD card within minutes of the shot
ground_events.event: Within minutes of the shooting, Farnsworth removed the camera positioned behind Kirk and took the SD card out himself, later transferring its contents to a flash drive -- which is what law enforcement actually received, rather than the original media. TPUSA's position is that officers instructed staff to secure equipment; Candace Owens disputes that account. Judge Tony Graf later sustained a defense objection and required prosecutors to produce the original, unaltered footage.

ground_events.headline: Loaded into the evacuation SUV
ground_events.event: Moved into the evacuation SUV. Occupants per Frank Turek's account and independent identification: Justin Davis (driving), Dan Flood (TPUSA security director, navigating), Rick Cutler (holding Kirk's head), Brian Harpole (security chief, near Kirk's legs), Frank Turek (entered from the rear).

ground_events.headline: In the evacuation SUV, near Kirk's legs
ground_events.event: Per Frank Turek's account and independent identification of the SUV occupants: Harpole was positioned near Kirk's legs during the evacuation drive.

ground_events.headline: Entered the evacuation SUV from the rear
ground_events.event: Per Turek's own account, he entered the evacuation SUV from the rear and rode with Kirk to Timpanogos Regional Hospital.

ground_events.headline: Drove the evacuation SUV
ground_events.event: Identified as the driver of the evacuation SUV, per Frank Turek's account and independent identification of the occupants.

ground_events.headline: Navigating in the evacuation SUV
ground_events.event: Identified as navigating during the evacuation drive to Timpanogos Regional Hospital, per Frank Turek's account and independent identification of the occupants.

ground_events.headline: Holding Kirk's head in the evacuation SUV
ground_events.event: Identified as holding Kirk's head during the evacuation drive, per Frank Turek's account and independent identification of the occupants.

ground_events.time_label: Shortly after 12:25 PM MDT — exact time not public
ground_events.headline: Departs toward the hospital
ground_events.event: Departs UVU toward Timpanogos Regional Hospital, Orem. No exact departure or arrival time, or surveyed route, is publicly documented — direction shown is illustrative only.

ground_events.headline: Enters the wooded escape route (1st of 2)
ground_events.event: Surveillance shows Robinson entering the wooded area along the escape route — the first of two documented entries. The rifle — an older .30-06 Mauser wrapped in a towel — was recovered there.

ground_events.headline: Enters the wooded area a second time
ground_events.event: Second documented entry into the wooded area per surveillance testimony. A disputed, uncorroborated claim alleges an earlier K9/line search of this same area found nothing first — see Contradictions tab / Official Conduct C12.

ground_events.headline: Evidence collection begins at the scene
ground_events.event: Utah DPS/SBI Sergeant Jennifer Faumuina oversees evidence collection at UVU, including the rooftop scene and items later tied to the case (towel, screwdriver). Lead SBI investigator David Hull and co-lead Brian Davis direct the broader investigation.
